text:
Maya (CSM): Quick capture from TideLabs after onboarding. They reported three asks and one ops pain that they say could affect renewal: (1) hide token-level billing per route (admin toggle), (2) bulk CSV export of flagged transcripts, (3) per-project embedding cache invalidate + TTL. Ops: unexpected retry storms when a variant fails during nightly jobs.

Ravi (PM): thanks. Can you paste their note and any sample CSV header? need exact fields to spec. Also: rank by impact.

Maya (CSM): redacted excerpt: "Finance is confused by token columns, want an admin toggle per route. Need CSV dump of flagged items for PM import. Need a way to clear embeddings after retrain. Fallback retries during night jobs cause surprise spend."

Kim (Support): sample CSV they attached:
```
project,route,user,flagged_at,reason,snippet,model
tidelabs,route-main,u_44,2026-03-19T03:05:00Z,privacy,"please remove email",gptx-3b
```

Sasha (Eng): per-route toggle seems small: add boolean on Route + UI switch + export filter. Estimate 2-4 dev days. CSV export: medium. Retry mitigation: cap retries + backoff (short-term ~2 days).

Diego (Ops): telemetry: TideLabs ~80k tokens/day; fallback rate last 7d ~13% with spike 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll add alert for fallback_rate >10% over 6h.

Ravi (PM): proposed prioritization: 1) billing toggle (high ROI, quick), 2) CSV export (medium), 3) retry cap (short term ops), 4) cache controls (longer UX). Agree?

Maya (CSM): action items:
- Maya: confirm CSV fields with customer (EOD)
- Ravi: PRD stub + estimates (this week)
- Sasha: deliver retry cap POC + metrics (next Tue)
- Diego: add alert + sprint task
- Kim: prep demo CSV for sync

ticket-bot: Created ticket CS-4101 "TideLabs: billing visibility + feedback export + cache/ops" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4101).

Maya (CSM): will schedule a 30m check-in with TideLabs next Wed and include eng/ops. They mentioned renewal concern: "If we can't hide billing noise the CFO may pause renewal."

Ravi (PM): noted. We'll surface progress in the renewal deck and update the ticket.

Sasha (Eng): pseudo for retry cap to include in ticket:
```
if (req.retries >= 2) return error('fallback_limit');
await retryWithBackoff();
```
